skills.expectation: Write joins, group-bys and subqueries on real business tables without help
Build clear dashboards and charts that answer a business question
Use Python for analysis when spreadsheets are not enough
Explain averages, distributions and significance to a non-technical manager
Find and fix duplicates, missing values and inconsistent formats
Clean and analyse a few thousand rows in Excel or Google Sheets, still expected by most Indian employers
Present findings as a short story with a clear recommendation
Build a Tableau dashboard, the most-mentioned BI tool in global postings
Build a Power BI dashboard with basic DAX, the most common BI tool in Indian postings
Explore data in Looker or Looker Studio
Use window functions and CTEs for running totals, ranks and cohorts
Query data in Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift
Turn SQL queries into tested dbt models
Understand how data reaches your tables and spot pipeline problems
Read the result of a simple A/B test
Use AI assistants to speed up queries and analysis, and check their output
Build pivot tables and use XLOOKUP or INDEX-MATCH

The standard Power BI credential, useful because most Indian analyst roles use Power BI
Worth it if you target companies that use Tableau
